original_name: 女潜入捜査官の変態痴育 ～娼婦のように乱れる八雲～
source:
To investigate the organization, Yakumo infiltrated one of its bases—a brothel.
But the organization already knew who she was.
Under the guise of work, they subjected her to increasingly lewd tasks, all part of a plan to mold her into a double agent through a twisted form of pleasure conditioning.
And so, Yagumo found herself trapped and manipulated, with no way out…
